another basic markets rule

when someone with 0 experience asks if they should buy [any IPO at 100x sales]

and you give the only responsible answer (“no, buy the index”)

the ipo will go up every single day, and they will hate you.

maybe “idk” is the best answer instead of “no”

basic markets rule

learn it the easy way (now) vs hard way (future)

never recommend stocks to friends or family.

if the stock goes up, it was their idea.

if the stock goes down, it was YOUR idea.

100% lose-lose situation.

always answer "go buy SPY," and then keep it moving.
